note: Marinette County publishes zoning only as a PDF zoning map and as File Geodatabase zips (2021 and 2023 countywide zoning, general and shoreland) on UW-Madison GeoData. Neither is a queryable ArcGIS/WFS/OGC service, and the runtime cannot read file geodatabases (validation: 'the zip has no .shp'). The county's Land Information Portal (mcgis) exposes only parcel/CAD services (UW_Marinette_* MapServers) with no zoning layer. No city zoning layer found for the largest cities (City of Marinette has a zoning map link only, no service).
